title: Potential of utilizing plant stem waste as an excellent source of dietary fiber for novel food applications
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2332-2359
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00591D, Review Article
Open Access

P. D. N. Boteju, C. M. Senanayake, K. G. L. R. Jayathunge
This review examines plant stem waste as a dietary fiber source, highlighting how stem structure, lignification, and green extraction methods affect fiber yield, functionality, and sustainable food use.
